alerts.headline: From 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. Wednesday, Aug. 19, the right lane of westbound State Route 18 will close west of Southeast Auburn-Black Diamond Road (milepost 5) for maintenance. From 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Thursday, Aug. 20, the right lane of eastbound SR 18 will close in this area.
Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from milepost 11.5 to milepost 10.85 will be closed overnight, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 5:30 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.

From as early as 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday, Aug. 16, through Wednesday morning, Aug. 19, the eastbound I-90 off-ramps to 148th and 150th Avenues Southeast will close. Signed detours will guide people around the closures. 

These closures support ongoing guardrail installation on eastbound I-90.

All lanes of southbound I-405 from Coal Creek Parkway Southeast to North 30th Street will be fully closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 21 – 4 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24. Signed detours will be in place.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from Lake Washington Boulevard Southeast (milepost 9) to North 30th Street (milepost 6.5) will be closed overnight, 11 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 7 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.
The northbound I-405 HOV off-ramp to Northeast Sixth Street will be closed overnight, 9 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 8 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15. A signed detour will be in place.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Lake Washington Boulevard/Newcastle will be fully closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 21 – 4 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24. Signed detours will be in place.

From as early as 9 p.m. Sunday, Aug. 16, to 5 a.m. Monday, Aug. 17, and again from at the same times Wednesday and Thursday nights, Aug. 19-20, the eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard SE will close for guardrail installation. 

Signed detours will guide people around the ramp closure.
All southbound I-405 off-ramps to westbound I-90 will be closed overnight, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Aug 14 to 5:30 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15. A signed detour will be in place.
The Coal Creek Parkway Southeast on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be fully closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 21 – 4 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24. Signed detours will be in place.
The Lake Washington Boulevard/Newcastle on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be fully closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 21 – 4 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24. Signed detours will be in place.

The Northeast 10th Street on-ramps to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly, 9 p.m. Monday, Aug. 10 to 5 a.m. Friday, Aug. 14. A signed detour will be in place. The on-ramps to westbound and eastbound SR 520 will also be closed.

From as early as 9 p.m. Sunday, Aug. 16, to 5 a.m. Monday, Aug. 17, and again from at the same times Wednesday and Thursday nights, Aug. 19-20, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from Bellevue Way SE will close for guardrail installation. 

Signed detours will guide people around the ramp closure.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 from Coal Creek Parkway Southeast (milepost 10) to Northeast Sixth Street (milepost 13.8) will be closed overnight, 10 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 8 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.

From as early as 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday. Aug. 16, to Friday morning, Aug. 21, up to two lanes of eastbound I-90 will close between Bellevue Way SE and 150th Avenue SE for guardrail installation. Delays are possible through the work zone.

Starting at 12:01 a.m. Monday, Aug. 17, both directions of SR 169 will close between Southeast 332nd Street and Plass Road near Jones Lake for 35 days for fish barrier removal. 

Separate signed detours will guide passenger vehicles and freight vehicles around the closure. 

Local access is permitted north and south of the closure, and businesses are open and accessible along SR 169.

One general-purpose lane of eastbound SR 522 from Campus Way Northeast (milepost 10.4) to 131st Avenue Northeast (milepost 11.4) will be closed nightly from 8 p.m. Monday, Aug. 10 to 4:30 a.m. Friday, Aug. 14 and from 8 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 9 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.

Until further notice: Daily from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. State Route 202/Woodinville-Redmond Road Northeast traffic will alternate with flaggers from State Route 522 to 131st Avenue Southeast (milepost 0) for a city of Woodinville utilities project.

From June 26 to Monday, Aug. 31: Daily from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. expect intermittent lane closures on State Route 202/131st Avenue Southeast from State Route 522 to Railroad Crossing (milepost 0) for city of Woodinville utilities work. Little Bear Creek Parkway will be open to local traffic with intermittent flagging and lane closures.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 160th Street will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. Tuesday, Aug. 11 to 4 a.m. Friday, Aug. 14 and overnight from 11 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to SR 527 will be closed nightly from 11:59 p.m. Wednesday, Aug. 12 to 5 a.m. Friday, Aug. 14 and from 12:30 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15 to 7 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.

The right lane of the eastbound SR 522 off-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. Monday, Aug. 10 to 4 a.m. Friday, Aug. 14 and overnight from 10 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.

The right lane of the northbound I-405/Northeast 160th Street off-ramp to eastbound SR 522 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. Tuesday, Aug. 11 to 5 a.m. Friday, Aug. 14 and overnight from 10:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 8 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.

The right general-purpose lane of northbound I-405 between Northeast 195th Street (milepost 24.8) and Damson Road (milepost 29.0) will be closed overnight from 8:30 p.m. Thursday, Aug. 13 to 5 a.m. Friday, Aug. 14 and from 8:30 p.m. Aug., 14 to 9 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15

Flaggers and pilot vehicles will alternate traffic from 8 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Aug. 17, through Wednesday morning, Aug. 19, near Northeast Carnation Farm Road (milepost 7) for pavement repairs and sealing.
From 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Tuesday, Aug. 18, the left lane of westbound State Route 18 from Interstate 5 to Weyerhauser Way (milepost 0) will close for maintenance.

Daily from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. beginning Wednesday, Aug. 19 to 6 p.m. Friday, Aug. 21, expect flaggers on the State Route 520 pedestrian trail at 84th Avenue Northeast/Hunts Point Circle (milepost 4) for utilities work.
From 8 a.m. to noon, Sunday, Aug. 16, contractor crews will alternate traffic on 229th Avenue Southeast and Southeast 66th Street between East Lake Sammamish Parkway and 230th Avenue Southeast.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.
Friday, August 14 to the morning of Monday, August 17: The southbound I-405 on-/off-ramps to Northeast 85th Street will be closed from 10 p.m. - 5 a.m.
Friday, August 14 to the morning of Monday, August 17: The northbound I-405 on-/off-ramps to Northeast 85th Street will be closed from 10 p.m. - 5 a.m.

From 10 p.m. Friday, Aug. 7, to 5 a.m. Monday, Aug. 17, all lanes of SR 161 will close between 28th Avenue South and Military Road South for installation of two fish-passable culverts. 

Signed detours will guide people around the closure, which will be in place 24 hours a day.

Starting at 12:01 a.m. Monday, July 13, the right lane on northbound and southbound SR 161 will close around the clock between South 370th Street and Military Road. 

One lane will remain open in each direction, but delays are likely through the work zone. 

This closure supports preliminary work on a fish barrier removal project planned for summer 2026 that will replace three culverts beneath SR 161.

Until further notice, SR 161 is reduced to one lane in each direction between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East on North Hill due to slide activity. Travelers can expect shifted lanes and congestion approaching North Hill.

Up to two lanes of northbound I-405 from North 30th Street (milepost 6.5) to Lake Washington Boulevard Southeast (milepost 9.3) will be closed overnight, 10 p.m. Friday Aug. 14 to 7 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.
Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 from SR 167 (milepost 2) to Sunset Boulevard North (milepost 4.5) will be closed overnight, 10:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 8 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15.
The SR 169 on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight, 11 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15. A signed detour will be in place.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 44th Street will be fully closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 21 – 4 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24. Signed detours will be in place.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 44th Street will be closed overnight, 9 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 8 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15. A signed detour will be in place.
The Northeast 44th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be fully closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 21 – 4 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24. Signed detours will be in place.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to North 30th Street will be fully closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Aug. 21 – 4 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24. Signed detours will be in place.

From 5 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15 to 11:59 p.m. Sunday, Aug. 17 and from 5 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 22 to 12 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24, all lanes of the northbound State Route 99 First Avenue South Bridge will close, from SR 509 to East Marginal Way. The South Holden Street on-ramp to northbound SR 99 and the northbound SR 99 off-ramp to South Michigan Street will also close. No pedestrian or bike access will be available.

From 5 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15 to 12 a.m. Monday, Aug. 17 and again from 5 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 22 to 12 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24, the northbound State Route 509 on-ramps from First Avenue South and Occidental Avenue South (milepost 29) will close for maintenance, as part of the northbound State Route 99 First Avenue South bridge closure.

From 10 p.m. Friday, Aug. 14 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15, both directions of the State Route 99 tunnel will close for maintenance. Northbound SR 99 will close just north of South Spokane Street (milepost 29) and southbound SR 99 will close just south of Raye Street (milepost 34). Southbound SR 99 will exit at the Harrison Street off-ramp, and northbound SR 99 will exit at Alaskan Way South. The Royal Brougham Way/Colorado Avenue South on-ramp and Sixth Avenue North on-ramp will also close.
From 9:30 p.m. Thursday, Aug. 20 to 5 a.m. Friday, Aug. 21, the eastbound Spokane Street Viaduct ramp to eastbound South Columbian Way (milepost 162) will close for maintenance.
The Harvard Avenue on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until mid-October for the Revive I-5 Ship Canal Bridge construction project.
The express lanes are northbound-only 24 hours a day through the end of 2026 due to lane reductions for construction on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge.
The express lanes will operate northbound-only 24 hours a day until the end of the year, to support  Revive I-5 northbound construction.
From Tuesday, July 27 to Tuesday, Sept. 8, the Ninth Avenue on-ramp to the northbound Interstate 5 express lanes (milepost 165) is closed for a Seattle Convention Center event.
From 8:30 to 11:30 a.m. Wednesday, Aug. 19, US 2 traffic will alternate with flaggers near Money Creek Campground (milepost 46) for maintenance.
Daily from 8:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. beginning Tuesday, Aug. 18 to 2:30 p.m. Thursday, Aug. 20, one right lane of southbound Interstate 5 will close near Klickitat Road (milepost 154) for maintenance.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Aug. 10, through Friday morning, Aug. 14, and again from Monday, Aug. 17, to Wednesday Aug. 19, portions of SR 202 will reduce to one lane between Woodinville and Redmond for crack sealing and pavement repair. 

Flaggers will alternate traffic through the work zone, which will shift nightly as crews make progress with pavement repairs.

Daily from 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. (except Saturday, Sunday) beginning July 10 to 4 p.m. Monday, Aug. 31, one right lane of both directions of the Interstate 5 on-ramp from East Grand Avenue/East Marine View Drive will close for utilities work.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.
Daily from 9 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. beginning Tuesday, Aug. 18 to 2:30 p.m. Thursday, Aug. 20, the left lane of the southbound SR 529 Snohomish River Bridge (milepost 4) will close for maintenance.

From 8 to 10 a.m. Tuesday, Aug. 18, the right lane of northbound State Route 529 will close from East Marine View Drive to Ross Avenue (milepost 4) for maintenance. From noon to 2 p.m., the right lane of southbound SR 529 in this area will close.

Westbound SR 524/196th Street SW has been reduced to one lane and eastbound SR 524/196th Street SW has been reduced to two lanes, 24 hours a day, near the I-5 interchange for a city of Lynnwood construction project.
From 8 p.m. Wednesday, Aug. 19 to 5 a.m. Thursday, Aug. 20, State Route 96 traffic will alternate with flaggers for utilities work.

Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Monday, Aug. 17 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Aug. 19, the right lane of southbound State Route 527 from 186th Place Southeast to 180th Street Southeast (milepost 5) for utilities work.

Until 5 a.m. Monday, Aug. 31: Nightly (except Saturdays) from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Sunday, Aug. 9, the right lane of eastbound State Route 96 from State Route 527/Bothell-Everett Highway (milepost 1) to west of Seattle Hill Road/132nd Street Southeast (milepost 2) for SnoPUD utilities work.

Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Monday, Aug. 17 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Aug. 19, three left lanes of northbound Interstate 5 will close from 164th Street Southwest (milepost 183) to 112th Street (milepost 187) for maintenance. From 9 p.m. Tuesday, Aug. 18 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Aug. 19, the South Everett Park & Ride off-ramp from northbound I-5 will also close.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).
From 10:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Saturday, Aug. 15, the right lane of State Route 525/Mukilteo Speedway from Third Street to the Mukilteo Ferry Landing (milepost 8) will close for maintenance.

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.
From 5:30 to 10:30 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 15 and from 5:30 to 9 a.m. Sunday, Aug. 16, State Route 9 traffic will alternate with flaggers over the Snohomish River Bridge (milepost 9) for maintenance.
